jobs.occupation: Flight Control System (FCS) / Flight Management System (FMS) equipment design responsible (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

Are you ready to dive into the world of aerospace while taking our flying weapon systems to the next level?

At Airbus Defence and Space in Manching (Ingolstadt), we are looking for a

FLIGHT CONTROL SYSTEM (FCS) / FLIGHT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (FMS) Equipment Design Responsible (d/m/f)

YOUR MISSION

​The position offers a multitude of activities incl. equipment responsibility, D3Q (Design, Development, Demonstration and Qualification) activities, technical management of suppliers for various Weapon Systems e.g. Eurodrone, Eurofighter and Future Combat Air System incl. RC (Remote Carrier

You will be part of a dynamic international team and will be in direct contact with our customers and suppliers. Particular activities can also be agreed to be carried out within the framework of "mobile work".

YOUR LOCATION (Manching / Ingolstadt)

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given special consideration.

WHAT WE OFFER/ OUR BENEFITS

- Your space, your vibe: whether hybrid working or office - you decide where you are most productive, within the framework of our company agreement (Betriebsvereinbarung)
- Flexibility according to your rhythm: Fixed working hours were yesterday. You decide when you perform best within the framework of our company agreement (Betriebsvereinbarung)
- Your knowledge, your power: Learn continuously and stay at the forefront thanks to our training opportunities
- Time to relax: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation with room to grow
- Earnings that show: In addition to attractive compensation, you can also expect special payments
- Let's Connect: Employee events for strong cohesion and networking
- Enjoyment included: A canteen and cafeteria await you in Manching

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Responsibility for FCS and FMS Equipment Design within various Weapon Systems e.g. Eurofighter, FCAS and Eurodrone and future adventures.
- Management of statutory, functional, performance, system and technical requirements from higher level architecture and specifications (internal and external), and allocation to the corresponding equipment.
- Generation and maintenance of the technical contract documents (Equipment specifications (PTS), Data Requirement List, Equipment Engineering Design, Requirement Documents, FRD, and Equipment Interface Control Document).
- Management of Equipment D3Q (incl. development in accordance with hardware standard DO-254 and other applicable standards), Obsolescence and Re-Design.
- Technical management of supplier including: selection process, D3Q activities, milestone management, Stage of Involvement Reviews (SOIs), validation and acceptance of deliverable items, DDPs, limitations and deviations, support and assessment of defect investigations and repairs, harmonization and control of supplier and program plans.
- Responsible for compliance to technical contract documents, equipment change management and build standard management.
- Support stakeholder requests concerning Equipment queries, defects and problem investigations.
- Support Equipment Integration Testing
- Liaison and coordination with other disciplines, departments (EMC, RM&T, ILS, QA ...) and the customer (incl. national airworthiness authorities (NAAs) e.g. LufABw).

YOUR PROFIL

- Study Hero: University (Master) degree in Electrical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering or equivalent
- At least 3 years of professional experience
- Knowledge and practical expertise with airborne equipment regarding:
- Very good: Qualification & Certification, Safety, Airworthiness, Reliability and Maintainability, ....
- Good: Hardware DAL A development (DO254 and ARP4754A, AMC 20-152A)
- Basic: Software DAL A development (DO178),
- Tech Insider:  Knowledge and experience in environmental, robust and certifiable hardware design according to DO-160, MIL-STD-810 in order to ensure supplier hardware design is certifiable

Champions League

- Experience in requirements engineering and requirements tools with DOORs or similar
- Experience in equipment and hardware certification
- Experience in technical supplier management
- Experience in analogue hardware as well as complex hardware design and verification
- Knowledge in digital computing as well as analytical and signal processing skills
- Supervise suppliers and internal stakeholders
- Knowledge about the Eurofighter, FCAS, Eurodrone and other Weapon Systems are welcomed
- Teamplayer and international driver: Demonstrated ability to work independently and in collaboratively manner within an international team, including the ability to coordinate and influence people.
- Language Champion: Business-fluent English, German is a plus.

The willingness to travel on business is required.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. As a Senior Portfolio Development Director, you will be a key leader in our team , responsible for the strategic development and management of the Designcenter portfolio within Global Industry Strategy and Portfolio GTM organization. You will lead a team of Portfolio Development Managers and ensure that our portfolio strategy is closely aligned with the overarching business objectives of Siemens Digital Industries Software. Your expertise and leadership are crucial for the expansion and growth of Designcenter, and thus for the success of our customers.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Development
• Lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive portfolio strategy aligned with Zone-level objectives
• Partner with Zone executives to define sales pipeline strategy and understand Portfolio Development contribution requirements
• Identify market opportunities, trends, and customer needs to drive continuous portfolio development and adaptation
• Translate complex market and business requirements into concrete, actionable portfolio strategies

Team Leadership and Development
• Lead, motivate, and develop a team of Portfolio Development Managers
• Make personnel decisions including recruitment, training and development, and performance management in accordance with relevant regulations
• Coach and mentor Portfolio Development Managers to foster professional growth and establish best practices

Business Operations and Performance Management

• Monitor and analyze portfolio performance, derive optimization measures, and report findings to management
• Drive results-orientation and operational excellence in a dynamic environment

Collaboration and Initiatives
• Actively participate in Zone-level meetings and contribute to planning and reporting for required activities
• Contribute to Zone and global initiatives stemming from agreed priorities and strategy

Qualifications

• Extensive experience in Portfolio Management, Product Management, or a similar strategic role, ideally in the software sector (PLM, MES, IoT, EDA, or comparable)
• Proven leadership experience in leading and developing teams in a complex, international environment
• Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate market and business requirements into portfolio strategies
• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills at all levels, both internally and externally
• Profound knowledge of business operations, budget management, and reporting

Why Us?

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

The total cash compensation range for this position is €174.600 to €349.300 with 50% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ (https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Chapter Lead HR Data Platform and Reporting (f/m/d), you will lead a team of specialists responsible for Siemens Energy’s strategic central HR master data platform, HR Data Hub, data quality engineering capabilities, local German reporting, and the central HR reporting landscape. You will steer and drive the roadmaps for homegrown HR data and reporting applications that are critical for reliable master data, trusted workforce reporting, and data-driven HR decision-making. The role combines people leadership, deep IT and data platform understanding, application ownership, product roadmap management, stakeholder partnering, data governance, operational excellence, and transformation delivery across a complex global HR technology landscape.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Steer the strategy, roadmap, and operational ownership of the HR Data Hub, ensuring it serves as the central HR master data platform for Siemens Energy with reliable and standardized data products.
* Drive the HR realted global Reporting by providing consultancy to the Business stakeholders and Support the internal Team with feedback and Innovations.
* Lead the development of data quality engineering capabilities for HR master data, emphasizing rules, validation logic, monitoring concepts, and continuous improvement measures.
* Translate business data quality requirements into scalable technical designs and reusable engineering patterns across the HR Data Hub and related reporting applications.
* Partner with HR process owners and technical teams to enhance data completeness, accuracy, and consistency, while establishing transparent escalation and remediation processes for cross-system HR master data issues.
* Steer the modernization of local German HR reporting solutions and the central HR reporting landscape, ensuring reliable delivery for operational, management, and regulatory reporting needs.
* Provide strong technical leadership for homegrown HR data and reporting applications, ensuring secure and compliant operations in alignment with IT architecture and cybersecurity standards.

What You Bring

* University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification.
* Longstanding experience in IT application management, data platform ownership, HR technology, reporting solutions, or digital product leadership.
* Proven experience managing business-critical, homegrown applications or data platforms in complex international environments.
* Strong experience with HR master data, data integration, data quality, reporting, analytics, or workforce reporting landscapes is highly desirable.
* Hands-on understanding of cloud-based data platforms, Snowflake or comparable data technologies, ETL/ELT concepts, APIs, data products, and modern software delivery practices is a strong advantage.
* Fluency in both German and English together with experience leading international teams, virtual organizations, or chapters in an agile, product-oriented, or platform engineering environment.
* Proven track record of stakeholder management, business partnering, roadmap steering, vendor governance, and transformation delivery at senior levels.

About the Team

Our Global Functions are essential in driving the company's strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across various departments, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you contribute to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external stakeholders, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The EMEA Service Delivery Lead is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Leadership & Operations

- Lead and develop a regional team of SD Managers responsible for engineering support across EMEA sites.- Own regional SLO/SLA performance; ensure targets are met, tracked, and reported consistently.- Drive operational consistency across EMEA sites aligned to global GES standards and Global Operations Excellence (GOE) defined processes.- Act as the primary escalation point for EMEA service issues, customer concerns, and critical incidents.- Ensure CMDB accuracy, asset management, and monitoring compliance across EMEA sites.

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join us in shaping the future of drug discovery.
In this exciting role, you will actively drive the establishment and advancement of oligonucleotide-based drug discovery capabilities within Medicinal Chemistry, leveraging your expertise in oligonucleotide synthesis to create innovative therapeutic solutions. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, first-in-class drug candidates within competitive timelines while advancing new therapeutic concepts and modalities for targets of interest. Guided by a passion for excellence in drug design, synthesis, lead identification, and optimization, you will collaborate with world-class scientists and make a meaningful impact on the development of next-generation medicines.
Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help transform groundbreaking science into life-changing therapies.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will drive the technical execution of siRNA projects.
- You will execute solid-phase oligonucleotide synthesis at research to mid-scale using RNA synthesizers, applying both routine and next-generation phosphoramidite chemistries.
- Furthermore, you will plan, optimize and trouble-shoot methods to improve coupling, capping, deprotection, cleavage, yield, purity and scalability, and oligonucleotide conjugation chemistries.
- You will coordinate and perform purification, desalting and analytical characterization of oligonucleotides.
- Moreover, you will operate, maintain and troubleshoot critical laboratory instrumentation, and take accountability for the oligonucleotide synthesis facility.
- You will train and coordinate Laboratory Scientists, providing technical guidance and fostering knowledge sharing across the team.
- Finally, you will document results with a high level of accuracy and reproducibility, contribute to patent applications, and provide technical expertise as a hands-on point of contact for synthesis and purification questions in project teams.

Requirements

- Completed vocational training or Master's or Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline with extensive hands-on experience in oligonucleotide synthesis
- Strong practical expertise in solid-phase synthesis, deprotection, purification and analytical characterization of oligonucleotides including method development and optimization
- Sound knowledge of oligonucleotide conjugates, linker chemistry, and bioconjugation approaches
- Hands-on experience with laboratory instrumentation used in oligonucleotide synthesis and analysis; experience in setting up or managing an oligonucleotide laboratory is highly desirable
- Interest in innovative RNA therapeutics and modern drug discovery.
- Independent, structured and reliable working style.
- Collaborative and team-oriented mindset with excellent interpersonal and communication skills
- Fluency in written and spoken English, coupled with a willingness to acquire basic German language skills

Start date: ASAP
As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package. Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

jobs.occupation: Office Manager:in (m/w/d) (Office-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
As Office Operations Manager, you'll be the backbone of our day-to-day office operations and the person who keeps everything running smoothly even when things get busy.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment: you'll be balancing planned projects with spontaneous requests that need to be handled on the spot. It is the exact opposite of monotonous and will give you lots of opportunity to get creative and bring ideas. Aside from the operational duties, you also make sure our people feel genuinely at home in the office.

If you're an organizational talent who thrives on taking ownership, enjoys variety, and stays composed when priorities shift unexpectedly, this role is for you!

This is a** full-time**, Berlin-based position with an immediate start.

Your mission

- Own and optimize office operations, including procurement processes, supplier management, and inventory control
- Ensure the office, workspaces, kitchen, and common areas are always well-organized, well-maintained, and fully functional
- Handle day-to-day operational tasks such as receiving deliveries, coordinating larger orders, minor repairs, and organizing storage areas
- Juggle multiple ongoing tasks in a high-paced environment, while staying ready to jump on spontaneous, ad hoc requests and knowing how to prioritize on the fly
- Collaborate closely and continuously with IT, Finance, and People teams to ensure efficient, compliant processes
- Support Onboarding and Offboarding processes together with People Ops and IT
- Act as the central point of contact for external partners such as suppliers, insurance consultants and landlords
- Analyze office usage and costs, identify opportunities for optimization, and support reporting these
- Ensure compliance with health, safety, and security regulations
- Plan and organize internal events, and contribute to employee engagement and sustainability initiatives
- Stay flexible and adaptable as priorities shift, adjusting plans and approaches as the business needs evolve

Job requirements

What You Bring

- At least two years of experience in office management or a related field, ideally with a background in hospitality or event management
- Excellent written and spoken German (minimum C1 level) and English; additional European languages are a plus
- Strong organizational skills paired with a structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working
- A proactive attitude and positive energy that helps create a motivating and pleasant office atmosphere
- High resilience to stress and pressure, with the ability to stay calm, keep a clear overview, and juggle competing priorities in a fast-moving, high-paced environment
- Comfort with ambiguity and spontaneous requests; you know how to quickly assess what's urgent and adjust your plan accordingly
- A collaborative mindset: you're used to working cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders. Being a natural connector who communicates clearly across different stakeholders is key.
- A genuine sense for the needs of a modern office environment, and a drive to contribute to a positive workplace culture

What We Offer

- A spacious, dog-friendly office loft by the canal in Berlin-Kreuzberg, designed for collaboration and comfort.
- Flexible work arrangements, including remote work options and the ability to plan workations.
- A purpose-driven environment where you can grow as a Sustainability Ambassador and contribute to meaningful projects.
- An international and diverse team that values ownership, collaboration, and professional growth.
- Annual learning budget and regular internal workshops to support your continuous development.
- Sustainable commuting benefits, including the Deutschland Ticket and Job Bike program.
- Access to a city-wide gym membership and mental health support through Nilo.health.
- Complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, and snacks, along with regular team events and volunteering opportunities.
